features.feature_value: Uses repeated profanity to attack political figures/media/outgroups.
features.evidence_span: "Fuck Trump, Fuck Faux News, and Fuck this so-called \"manosphere\"."
features.rationale: The post contains multiple instances of explicit profanity aimed at political actors and affiliations.

features.feature_value: Triadic repeated structure 'Fuck X, Fuck Y, and Fuck Z'.
features.evidence_span: "Fuck Trump, Fuck Faux News, and Fuck this so-called \"manosphere\"."
features.rationale: The comma-separated, repeated imperative form targets several entities in a patterned escalation.

features.feature_value: Pejorative labels for ideologies/groups (e.g., neo Nazis, brain-dead, Antifa thugs).
features.rationale: The text labels in-group/out-group groups with dehumanizing/insulting ideological terms.

features.feature_value: “Silver lining/upside” justification that frames the opposing group as non-Americans to 'balance out'.
features.evidence_span: "The silver lining is that these people are often not even Americans so it balances out."
features.rationale: A justificatory moral/strategic claim is used to rationalize hostility toward the target group.

features.feature_value: Series of rhetorical questions about legality and staying status after crossing/bypassing rules.
features.evidence_span: "Illegal immigrants should stay? Seriously? Cross border illegally and hide long enough and you get to stay?"
features.rationale: The post uses successive “seriously?” rhetorical questions to challenge an immigration policy outcome.

features.feature_value: Focus on illegal immigration/crossing borders and deportation/stay permission.
features.rationale: Core subject matter is border crossing legality and residency/deportation decisions.

features.feature_value: All-caps exclamatory style ending with 'IT’S NEVER ENDING!!!' (also in mirror).
features.rationale: High-intensity capitalization and emphatic punctuation marks strong outrage and extremity of claims.

features.feature_value: Accusations of election interference/corruption with precise-sounding claims (Ukraine money funnel, fake IDs to vote).
features.evidence_span: "China Sent 105 Of Thousands Of Fake ID5 To Biden Camp To Illegally Vote In Presidential Election!!!"
features.rationale: The post advances sweeping, conspiratorial allegations presented as assertion (not hedged) about fraud and corruption.
